title: Lounge Member Fare Credit on Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
A holder of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes with an active membership in Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships receives a lounge fare credit against the companion fare, following the holder's active Summit Club product:

| Holder's active Summit Club product | Lounge fare credit on the companion fare |
|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive | 12 USD |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 12 USD |
| Summit Club Individual | 6 USD |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 6 USD |
| no active membership, or any other club product | nothing |

Only a Summit Club membership in active status is read.

**Hypothetical case.** An active Summit Club Executive member receives 12 USD; a member whose only Summit Club membership is Summit Club Essential receives nothing.
